title: Down But Not Out
summary:
Oil demand from North West Europe still relevant for tankers
Over the last 10-15 years the focus in world oil markets has been on Asian demand in general and the rapid growth in Chinese oil consumption in particular. On the supply side of the equation, the Middle East continued to be the focal point as the largest supply source, although other areas like Africa and Russia did become more important. More recently, production and exports from the United States have been getting a lot of the spotlight.
